summary: Built SL-043 as designed, with all accepted critique fixes. EntryClassifier now treats an entry as a link only when the reparse attribute is set and the tag has the name-surrogate bit (0x20000000); it checks the attribute first. A new Core/Scanning/VolumeSpace reads GetDiskFreeSpaceExW for whole-drive roots, via a Native wrapper that turns off the critical-error box for the call. The read starts as the scan's first statement, on its own background thread, and is capped at 30 s. It publishes into ScanStore.VolumeUsed (Task<long?>) through an internal VolumeUsedSource, and nothing in Core waits on it. MainWindow no longer has its DriveInfo query. It shows the ending at once and adds the volume line from a continuation that holds only the window, a scan generation number and the texts. New tests: an independent-listing check of a 498-character tree with hidden entries, run non-elevated; classifier rows; 363/1920 rows; VolumeUsageTests (Get-Volume bracket, null figures, stalled reads, WeakReference no-pin); and window cases V-001 and P-001. The three architecture rules now exist in both forms. Results: Core suite 240/240 in Debug and Release, 25 full Release runs all green, all 28 non-network window cases pass, and the shipped exe scanned all of C:\ with the new volume line.

files.why: Criterion 4: link = reparse attribute AND name-surrogate bit, attribute tested first; tag list removed; DFS consequence (m1) documented

REPARSE_TAG_NAME_SURROGATE and SEM_FAILCRITICALERRORS constants; GetDiskFreeSpaceExW and SetThreadErrorMode P/Invokes behind TryGetVolumeUsed, which suppresses the critical-error box around the call (m2)

IsDriveRoot (App rule moved, not widened) and Start: null at once for non-drive roots, otherwise a dedicated background thread that captures only the completion source, root and reader, plus a 30 s bound that completes null (M-add-1); never faulted
TaskCompletionSource<long?> (RunContinuationsAsynchronously) exposed as public Task<long?> VolumeUsed; internal VolumeUsedSource named so the no-wait rule matches it (M2)
VolumeSpace.Start as the first statement of Execute, before the pre-cancel return (m5); remarks
Test seams: VolumeReader, VolumeReadBound, ReadVolumeOfAnyRoot (M2 completed-path twin)
Kind docs follow the new link rule (DFS is a Folder, WSL symlinks are Links)

Deleted UnlessCancelled/VolumeInUse (DriveInfo). ShowOutcome runs at once; ShowVolumeInUse/AddVolumeInUse apply result.Store.VolumeUsed through a generation-checked dispatcher continuation that never holds the result or store (M1); EndingShown is raised once the volume line has settled
O-031 rewritten for the new placement; EntryClassifier paragraph (O-005) replaced with the surrogate rule and the DFS consequence (m1); three rules added to the rules table

Four twinned entries above the marker (TheClassifierListsNoLinkTags, NothingWaitsOnTheVolumeFigure (Core) and (App), TheVolumeReadHoldsNoScanStore); a comment on the engine-appended SL-043 settled entries, which are kept as declared
Three Facts twinning the rules; the no-wait Fact covers Core and App (M1)
Split into surrogate-link, non-surrogate-data and attribute-clear theories; DFS flips Link->Folder, LX_SYMLINK File->Link; four cloud tags, tag 0, 0xA0000010, and 0x20000000 with the attribute clear
363 and 1920 rows with and without a requested cancel, beside 0/5/995

Independent-listing Fact: asserts !Environment.IsPrivilegedProcess first (m4); a 9-level tree (folder paths to 457 characters, files to 486), hidden file and folder, compared with Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries over \\?\ with AttributesToSkip=0

DisableParallelization collection (M3): Get-Volume bracket with up to 3 attempts, folder null, IsDriveRoot table, no-volume letter, stalled drive-root cancel then null after the bound, completed scan with a stalled read, pre-cancelled scan, WeakReference no-pin
V-001 (SUBST drive root carries 'The volume reports' as line 3; the same tree by folder path has no such line) and P-001 (published exe on a >260/>400-character tree), both added to All

obligations.how: TraversalTests.AgreesWithAnIndependentListingOfADeepTreeAsAnOrdinaryUser builds a link-free tree through \\?\ paths (longest folder 457 and longest file 486 characters, each asserted), scans it, and rebuilds paths from the parent chain. It asserts ordinal set equality with Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries(\\?\root, AttributesToSkip=0, IgnoreInaccessible=false, MatchType=Simple), equal and distinct counts, status Completed, contiguous children, and first that the process is not elevated.

The same Fact puts a hidden file at level 6 and a hidden folder with one child at level 7. The reference listing uses AttributesToSkip=0, and the Fact asserts both entries are in the store carrying the Hidden attribute.

EntryClassifierTests.ANameSurrogateTagWithTheReparseAttributeIsALink covers 0xA0000003 dir, 0xA000000C dir and file, 0xA000001D file (flipped from File), 0xA0000010 dir, 0xA0000027 dir, and a symlink with a recall attribute. Every row is Link.
EntryClassifierTests.ANonSurrogateTagWithTheReparseAttributeIsData covers 0x9000201A/401A/601A/E01A, tag 0 and DFS 0x8000000A, each as dir (Folder) and file (File). The DFS row flipped from Link.

EntryClassifierTests.WithoutTheReparseAttributeTheTagFieldIsNeverRead covers 0x20000000, 0xA0000003, 0xA000000C and 0xFFFFFFFF in the tag field with the attribute clear. The results are Folder or File, never Link.

SynchronousIoCancelTests.OnlyARequestedCancelMakesAnAbortedCallACancellation gained rows for 363 and 1920, with and without a requested cancel, all Unreadable, beside the existing 0/5/995 rows (10 rows).

VolumeUsageTests.ASystemDriveScanRecordsWhatGetVolumeReports reads Get-Volume (powershell.exe) before the scan. It scans the system root with the real reader wrapped so the scan cancels in AfterFolder once the read has returned, awaits VolumeUsed with a bound, then reads Get-Volume again, and needs the figure inside [min-64MiB, max+64MiB]. 26 runs: all inside on the first attempt, largest drift 64 MiB and monotone.
VolumeUsageTests.AFolderScanRecordsNoFigure asserts that VolumeUsed is already completed with null when a %TEMP% folder scan returns.

VolumeUsageTests.OnlyAWholeDriveIsADriveRoot covers C:\, c:\ and \\?\C:\ (true), and C:\Users, \\server\share\, \\?\UNC\server\share\, a mount-point folder with and without a trailing backslash, and \\?\Volume{...}\ (false).

VolumeUsageTests.ADriveLetterWithNoVolumeRecordsNoFigure picks a free letter (Y: here) and asserts Kernel32.TryGetVolumeUsed returns false (error 3). It scans that root (RootUnreadable) and asserts the awaited figure is null and not faulted.

VolumeUsageTests.ADriveRootScanEndsWhileTheReadIsStalled scans the system root with a reader that blocks and a 5 s bound, cancelling after the root listing. It asserts status Cancelled, that the scan ended before the bound with VolumeUsed still pending, and then null after the bound. Mutation-checked: a Task.Wait on VolumeUsedSource at scan end makes the completed-path twin time out.

Window case P-001 runs the published single-file exe through eng/read-window.ps1 on a %TEMP% tree (18 folders, 27 files of 64 KiB, folders to 457 and files to 498 characters). It checks counts and bytes against the tree, no unreadable folders, and all 27 files in the largest-files list. Passed.

VolumeInUse and the DriveInfo volume query are gone from MainWindow (DriveInfo remains only for the drive list), and the outcome reads result.Store.VolumeUsed. Window case V-001 scans a SUBST drive root and asserts OutcomeDetail line 3 starts 'The volume reports ... in use, so'. The same tree scanned by folder path has 3 lines and no volume line. Passed, and the SUBST letter was removed.

Owed to validate-slice, not to this build. The measurement is evidence toward it: 25 full-suite Release runs plus the targeted runs all bracketed on attempt 1; drift was mostly 0, with -7.9 MiB, +0.6 MiB, -1 MiB and -64 MiB (monotone) seen once each. No run had other disk-heavy work going at the same time, apart from the suite itself.

ShowOutcome shows the ending at once without the figure. ShowVolumeInUse applies it later through Dispatcher.InvokeAsync from a ContinueWith, in its own method, so the closure holds only the window, a generation number and a texts record; a generation mismatch drops it. The no-wait rule now covers src/FsAnalyser.App/** as a twinned Fact and yaml entry. VolumeUsageTests.AStalledReadKeepsNoDroppedScanInMemory is the WeakReference test, mutation-checked to fail when the read's closure holds the store. Not done: the suggested StallRig private-bytes measurement. StallRig serves a UNC share with no drive letter, so it cannot produce a drive-root scan, and mapping one to a letter outside the rig breaks the SMB-mapping rule.

(a) ScanOptions.ReadVolumeOfAnyRoot plus VolumeReader: VolumeUsageTests.AScanCompletesWhileTheReadIsStalled scans a %TEMP% tree to Completed with a blocking reader, asserts VolumeUsed is pending, and asserts 42 once released. (b) The accessor is named VolumeUsedSource, so the existing pattern matches it; mutation-checked, since `_store.VolumeUsedSource.Task.Wait()` fails NothingWaitsOnTheVolumeFigure.

VolumeUsageTests is in [Collection(nameof(VolumeFigure))] with DisableParallelization = true. The bracket test takes up to three G1/figure/G2 attempts, passes on any inside, prints each (invariant culture), and fails listing all of them. Ran the full suite 20 times, logging the triples, then 5 more with exit codes: all green, all inside on attempt 1.

The 'never silent' rationale is gone. EntryClassifier remarks and the SL-020 EntryClassifier paragraph now say that through a share the SMB client follows a DFS referral, so the scan continues in the target share and FileId dedup and the listing class then span two volumes. That is accepted under criterion 4, marked as the critique's account and not measured here, and no unreadable record covers it.

Kernel32.TryGetVolumeUsed calls SetThreadErrorMode(SEM_FAILCRITICALERRORS) around GetDiskFreeSpaceExW and restores the old mode in a finally, so every caller gets the guard. DirectoryReader has no such guard to share (the scanner's own root open is unguarded; that predates this slice and is a follow-up).

No TokenElevation.cs helper. The Fact's first statement is Assert.False(Environment.IsPrivilegedProcess, ...), and it read False in testhost in every run here (Medium integrity, as the spike measured).

VolumeSpace.Start is the first statement of Run.Execute, before the pre-cancel return, and it arms the bound before starting its thread. VolumeUsageTests.AScanCancelledBeforeItStartsAnswersTheFigure asserts a pre-cancelled scan's VolumeUsed is completed with null; mutation-checked by moving Start after the check, which fails it.

VolumeSpace.Start arms Task.Delay(bound).ContinueWith(static ..., state: the completion source) calling TrySetResult(null). DefaultBound is 30 s and settable through ScanOptions.VolumeReadBound. ADriveRootScanEndsWhileTheReadIsStalled asserts pending at scan end and null after its 5 s bound.

Chose (a) without a schema change: OutcomeDetail in schema 1 already carries the line. To make the report deterministic, EndingShown for a whole-drive Finished or Stopped ending is raised after the line has settled. Window case V-001 asserts the line on a SUBST drive-root scan and its absence on the same tree scanned by folder path. Passed in isolation and in the full non-network run.

deviations: Architecture rules: the design says eng/rules-parity.ps1 fails on a rule present in only one copy. That is wrong: parity compares only the twinned entries above the first '# settled by' marker and just counts the settled ones below it, so the engine-appended SL-043 entries passed parity with no xUnit twin. I built the design's intent anyway: three [Fact]s, and four twinned yaml entries above the marker (the no-wait rule is split into Core and App scopes; App added per M1). I kept the engine's three settled SL-043 entries exactly as declared and added a comment above them saying they are also twinned. rules-parity: AGREE 11 facts <- 15 twinned entries, 27 patterns; 24 settled.

TokenElevation.cs helper and its contract were not built. m4 was accepted: Environment.IsPrivilegedProcess replaces it, and a P/Invoke under tests/ outside TestNative.cs would break InteropLivesOnlyInNative (tests).

Contract 'ScanStore.VolumeUsed: a read that never returns leaves it pending forever; the App waits on its existing post-scan thread' is superseded by the accepted M-add-1 and M1. The read has a 30 s bound that completes null. The App shows the ending at once and applies the figure from a generation-checked continuation, never waiting on it.

EndingShown (MainWindow) now fires, for a whole-drive Finished or Stopped ending, once the volume line has settled (the figure landed, or null at the bound) rather than at ShowOutcome. An ending replaced by a new scan before then raises nothing. The design did not specify this. Without it, the --report file could be written before the line lands and V-001 (M-add-2) would be a race. Only App report mode listens to EndingShown, and every folder or share ending still fires at once.

Contract '--report schema 1 unchanged; WindowCases.ps1 need no change': the schema is unchanged, but WindowCases.ps1 gained V-001 (M-add-2's accepted fix) and P-001 (C-013 is owed to build as a case that feeds the shape).

Test (1) 'scan cancelled right after the figure lands': the store cannot be reached from outside a running scan. The test instead wraps the real reader (VolumeSpace.Read) to signal when it returns, and cancels from ScanOptions.AfterFolder once the root listing has committed and the read has returned. The test seams live on the existing internal ScanOptions (VolumeReader, VolumeReadBound, ReadVolumeOfAnyRoot), not as a new Scanner parameter.

Visible behaviour change the design did not call out: a Stopped whole-drive ending now shows the volume line ('...not in this partial scan'). The read starts at scan start whatever happens to Cancel. The old App never started its query once Cancel was requested, so that branch of Coverage was effectively dead.
not_built: tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/TokenElevation.cs (design component): replaced by Environment.IsPrivilegedProcess per the accepted m4.

M1's suggested 'settle it for real' StallRig private-bytes measurement against a drive-root scan: StallRig serves a UNC share with no drive letter, and mapping one to a letter outside the rig breaks the SMB-mapping rule. The WeakReference test stands in for it.
follow_ups: eng/rules-harness/plants.json has no plant rows for the four new twinned entries (SL-040 added F17-F19 for its rule). They need a harness run with the TAAD engine (--engine-root), because plant outcomes must come from recorded runs. It was not run here.

tests/rules/RuleCases.ps1 hard-codes 'AGREE 8 facts <- 11 twinned entries, 23 patterns; 15 settled'. That was already stale before this slice (SL-039 and SL-042 raised settled to 21); it is now 11/15/27/24. C-001, C-003, C-004 and C-005 of that script will fail until someone refreshes the numbers.

DFS tension (m1): criterion 4 descends DFS folders, and through a namespace share that follows a referral into another server, where FileId dedup has no volume part. It is accepted and documented but not measured. A person may want to decide whether DFS stays descended.
SUBST letters and letters mapped to share subfolders pass IsDriveRoot and get the host volume's figure (m3, deferred). V-001 relies on exactly that.

The scanner's own root open, and SizeProbe, run without SEM_FAILCRITICALERRORS. A drive-root scan of an empty removable drive could still raise the 'insert a disk' box from the scan thread. This predates the slice (m2's decision puts it out of scope).
Stopped whole-drive endings now carry the volume line with 'of it is not in this partial scan' wording. It is the first time that text is live, and a person may want to look at it.
O-014 for validate: 25 full-suite runs bracketed on attempt 1 with at most 64 MiB of monotone drift. A run with heavy concurrent disk writes (another worktree's build or SDK download) was not tried.

tests.command: C:\Users\sshub\.claude\.venv\Scripts\python.exe - (fitness.yaml emulation: every rule's patterns over its glob, comments included)
tests.note: Every hit fell in an exempted file (Kernel32.cs, EntryClassifier.cs, TestNative.cs, SynchronousIoCancel.cs, SmbRig.cs) or in a comment the engine blanks for settled rules. No hits in changed or new files, and no rule matched no files. This is not the engine's Fitness.

Published the app. As SUBST drive Y:\ the ending had 4 lines, line 3 'The volume reports 763.3 GB in use, so 763.3 GB of it was not seen by this scan (...)'. By folder path it had 3 lines and no volume line. SUBST removed afterwards (subst lists nothing).
Published exe (no longPathAware manifest) on a tree with folders to 457 and files to 498 characters: counts and bytes match, no unreadable folders, 27/27 files in the largest-files list
PASSED: C-001..C-014, O-016, L-001..L-003, B-001..B-008, V-001, P-001 (28 cases). NOT RUN: N-001..N-004 (network, need -IncludeNetwork).

Real use: the freshly published exe in report mode on the whole system drive. EXIT 0, 'Finished: C:\', 3,588,639 files, 829,599 folders, 20,464 links not followed, 989.4 GB in files, 717.4 GB on disk. 'The volume reports 774.8 GB in use, so 57.4 GB of it was not seen by this scan (...)'. Read in 404.5 s. The unreadable-folders expander was shown. Get-Volume afterwards: 831,957,446,656 B (774.8 GiB).
